_comment: Run 1 — single deterministic permutation (roll-by-half), the original diagnose_visual_swap.py. Point estimate, NO confidence interval. Superseded for inference by the permutation-null run (see visual_swap_null_2026-07-16.json); kept because it is the run that reproduces the historical ~0.3% slowfast headline.
data: real fMRI val windows from manifest_mary_multi.json — NOT simulated
_loads_all_streams_note: This script calls model.load_state_dict(ckpt['state_dict']) WITHOUT the ACTIVE_STREAMS filter used by qualia/core/mary_engine.py, so the video encoders ARE loaded and active here. It measures the model with video genuinely switched on.
findings: POSITIVE CONTROL FIRES: shuffling audio+text together costs -55.0% of base accuracy (0.1297 -> 0.0583). The harness detects signal when signal is present, so the visual numbers are interpretable.
The historical ~0.3% headline REPRODUCES exactly, and is now identified: it was slowfast measured ALONE (-0.0004 = -0.32% of base).
That headline UNDERSTATED visual by ~15x. All three visual streams shuffled together cost -0.0059 (-4.56%), not -0.0004.

REDUNDANCY is the reason, and it is not specific to visual: the three audio/text streams individually sum to -0.036 but together cost -0.071, ~2x the sum. Single-stream ablation systematically understates every stream in this conjunctive-fusion architecture.
Text (qwen_ctx) is the single dominant stream at -19.6% of base — for a product selling visual creative analysis, the model leans hardest on the transcript.
Honest ratio: visual ~4.6% of responsive-vertex accuracy vs audio+text ~55%. Visual is not zero. It is ~12x less than sound and language.
limitations: ONE permutation, ONE batch. Point estimate with no confidence interval. -0.0713 is far too large to be noise; -0.0059 CANNOT be called distinguishable from zero on this run alone. See the permutation-null run.
Base accuracy is r=0.1297 on responsive vertices — low in absolute terms. All deltas are fractions of an already-small number.
Restricted to the 112 val windows that carry slowfast features.

DOES NOT ANSWER THE CAUSAL QUESTION. A near-zero ablation delta is equally consistent with (a) visual is non-predictive in this corpus and (b) the model learned an audio/text shortcut and routes around visual. Separating those requires finetune_visual_force.py, which forces visual-only prediction, then test_visual_divergence.py to score it.
why_this_matters: qualia/core/mary_engine.py:21 sets ACTIVE_STREAMS = ('beats','whisper','qwen_ctx'), so in production the visual streams are gated off entirely. The mary-readout-validation audit notes that Visual Attention, Face Processing and the Visual Pull composite are nevertheless computed and shown to customers — derived from audio and transcript. This run quantifies the ceiling on any honest visual claim: even with the video encoders loaded and active, visual content moves responsive-vertex accuracy by roughly 4.6%.
